Hi Samir — thanks for the screenshot, that helps.

Quick details: Gmail/Calendar sometimes rewrites a Meet link when an organizer forwards the invite or when a third-party mail gateway rewrites headers — that can cause recipient restrictions to kick in. Two immediate options:

- I can send a fresh calendar invite with a Zoom link and a one-time passkey (works for external SSO-restricted attendees).
- Or I can re-issue a Google Meet invite but set Redwood as the organizer (less ideal for your security folks).

Would you prefer Zoom with passkey or a Google Meet that we manage from our side? If Zoom, I can create a new invite and add the passkey in the body and attach a new .ics so your calendar accepts it. If you want a different time, say Friday 10am PT, I can update as well.

I'll queue up the Zoom reinvite unless you ask otherwise.
